test_reindex_basic: test the Series.reindex method to subset, identity-check, and handle non-contiguous indices
test_reindex_with_fill_method: test Series.reindex with pad, ffill, bfill, and nearest fill methods including tolerance parameters
test_reindex_with_fill_value: test Series.reindex with explicit fill_value for floats, ints, objects, and bools without upcasting
test_reindex_dtype_behavior: test Series.reindex with categorical, bool, int, datetime, timedelta, and nullable Float64Dtype series
test_reindex_multiindex: test Series.reindex against MultiIndex targets with automatic level matching by name
